exact_boundary.normalization: The finite first-event mass is 1-exp(-Lambda_z(T)); missing mass includes waits beyond T or infinite, never silently normalized away.

exact_boundary.parameter_scope: Each fixed y,xRef,z and finite T, with any Borel bounded h. No simultaneous all-parameter AE event or substitution of arbitrary correlated random initialization.
